name: Agency business development
description: For agencies and consultancies pitching a service. Leads with a result for a comparable client rather than a capabilities list, and offers something free that is actually free.
audience: Decision makers at companies matching the profile of your last three good clients — same size, same sector, same problem.

variants: {{firstName|Hi}} — we do this work for companies that look a lot like {{company|yours}}. Connecting rather than cold-pitching; you can judge the work later.
Hi {{firstName|there}} — we've just finished a project for a company almost identical to {{company|yours}}. Happy to connect and share what came out of it.
Thanks {{firstName|there}}. Concrete rather than vague: for a company your size we cut this from a six-week cycle to under two. Is that a number that would matter at {{company|your company}}?
The only useful thing I can tell you, {{firstName|there}}: last client, same size as {{company|you}}, went from six weeks to two. Relevant, or solving a different problem?
{{firstName|Hi}} — happy to do a short teardown of your current setup and send it over. Free, no call required, yours to keep whatever you decide.
Offer, {{firstName|there}}: we'll review what you have now and write up what we'd change. No charge, no meeting needed. Want it?
I'll stop here, {{firstName|there}}. The offer doesn't expire — come back when there's budget or a deadline.
Leaving it, {{firstName|there}}. When this becomes urgent at {{company|your company}}, we'll still be here.
